summary: Iteration 6 completed: added missing mocked backend contract coverage and executed authenticated owner browser checks via local Playwright + existing DB session token. Readiness truthfulness remains fixed ('NOT READY'/'Real execution blocked'). One critical owner-browser integration issue found on GitHub connect POST due origin allowlist mismatch.

critical.issue: From authenticated owner browser flow, POST can return 403 'Untrusted request origin' instead of expected inline validation path (e.g., 422 for issue_number=0), because middleware allowlist does not include observed browser Origin host variant.

integration_issues.flow: Owner Security → GitHub Connect form submit
integration_issues.issue: Expected invalid-form server validation path was blocked by origin policy (403), preventing normal inline 422 behavior from browser submission in this preview domain variant.

action_items: Update origin allowlist/validation logic so owner browser POSTs from actual preview origin variants are trusted (while preserving CSRF protections).
Re-test real (non-mocked) owner GitHub invalid-field 422 path after origin fix.
Re-run owner diagnostic gate click without route mock once model-count-enabled status is available from real API response.
critical_code_review_comments: Origin gate compares raw Origin against static env list; in this environment browser Origin can differ from forwarded host (observed: model-router-lab.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud), causing false 403 on legitimate owner UI POSTs.
Execution/readiness truthfulness fix remains correct in UI and API: status stayed NOT_READY / blocked with no fake readiness.
MOCKED browser checks were used only for failure-UX assertions (password clear and diagnostic-inline-409), explicitly not claiming real provider connectivity.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (owner authenticated/responsive checks passed; one critical POST origin-policy blocker)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner browser automation now works with local Playwright in /root/.venv (Chromium /usr/bin/chromium). Screens and JSON evidence are in /app/test_reports/iteration6_browser. Real owner POST /api/bounty/connections/github was blocked by origin policy in browser path; bearer-based API tests still pass. Data invariants observed: simulated jobs=2, simulated payments=3, external PRs=0, model_usage=0, verified_revenue=0.
rca of the issue: RCA: bounty_policy_boundary middleware enforces Origin allowlist for non-GET /api/bounty calls. Backend log recorded rejection with origin='https://model-router-lab.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud' while configured allowlist had 'https://execution-control-3.preview.emergentagent.com' and another domain, causing 403 'Untrusted request origin'. Repro: authenticated owner browser on /security -> submit GitHub connect form. Mitigation: include actual served preview origin variants (or normalize trusted host mapping) in origin check without weakening CSRF guarantees.
